card.name: The Fiend Megacyber
card.effect: If your opponent controls at least 2 more monsters than you do, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

supports: Special Summon effect can only be used during Main Phase

rules.procedure: Optional non-chain Special Summon from the physical owner's private hand
rules.condition: Opponent team controls at least two more monsters than the owner's team
rules.counting: All monsters count, including face-down monsters; teams share three Monster Zones
rules.timing: Main Phase only, per historical tournament ruling
rules.normalSummon: This procedure does not consume the Normal Summon; a separate Tribute Normal Summon remains a core-engine path
rules.handLimit: No discard occurs here; hand limit six is enforced at End Phase
rules.deckRules: 20–30 Main Deck cards and at most five Extra Deck cards per physical seat

tests: active physical owner and private hand
exact UID moves from hand to shared Monster Zone
Special Summon does not consume Normal Summon
seven-card hand is not prematurely discarded
wrong identity or non-hand source rejected
Main Deck maximum 30 and rejection at 31
Extra Deck maximum 5 and rejection at 6
production adapter pinned to official passcode
limitations: Adapter is isolated and is not connected to the M61 resolver/trigger queue.
Summon-negation chains and real Discord interaction are not modeled here.
No card certification is claimed; behavior requires resolver integration and end-to-end engine tests.

Because The Fiend Megacyber is not yet registered in the runtime catalog, behavioral tests inject a catalog-valid fixture ID through the adapter factory. The production entrypoint remains pinned to 66362965 and is not yet usable in a real duel until catalog registration and resolver handoff.
